relationships.subject: CX3CR1
relationships.evidence_quote: CX3CR1 expressing monocytes (Ly6ClowCCR2-) infiltrate the DRG at day 5 after K/BxN serum transfer, and absence of this chemokine receptor impairs such an infiltration

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Incubation of HUVECs with CGRP (1 µM overnight) resulted in a significant decrease of membrane-bound FKN expression

relationships.subject: olcegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: Olcegepant attenuated mechanical hypersensitivity from 3 h after the first injection of KBxN serum at day 0 for up to day 4

key_findings: CX3CR1 deletion reduced allodynia and DRG non-classical monocyte and macrophage infiltration in K/BxN arthritis without changing paw swelling.
Neuronal CGRP is upregulated in DRG and the CGRP antagonist olcegepant reduced swelling, allodynia and leukocyte infiltration.
